map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Henry, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-18 03:01): mail returned 2,972 (state 2,407); early in person 13,353 (state 11,324); ballots sent 15,453 (state 15,452). Clermont (as of 2026-10-17 23:56): mail returned 4,133 (state 2,500); early in person 6,024 (state 5,215). Crawford (as of 2026-10-16 15:51): mail returned 713 (state 461); early in person 1,247 (state 1,111). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-16 18:11): mail returned 33,902 (state 26,118); early in person 14,380 (state 12,396). Franklin (as of 2026-10-17 00:12): mail returned 22,976 (state 14,464); early in person 29,779 (state 25,409); ballots sent 76,978 (state 74,692). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-15 19:07): early in person 19,127 (state 18,934). Henry (as of 2026-10-16 15:37): early in person 1,143 (state 989). Morrow (as of 2026-10-16 15:49): mail returned 535 (state 344); early in person 1,182 (state 1,038). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-16 09:31): mail returned 2,789 (state 2,750).
